scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && bun run preview --port 4321 & sleep 5 && bunx playwright test tests/e2e/ && kill %1
scripts.test:e2e:ui: bun run build && bunx playwright test --ui
scripts.test:a11y: bun run build && bun run preview --port 4321 & sleep 5 && bunx playwright test tests/p1-accessibility.spec.ts && kill %1
scripts.test:visual: bun run build && bun run preview --port 4321 & sleep 5 && bunx playwright test tests/visual-regression/ && kill %1
scripts.test:p0: bun run build && bun run preview --port 4321 & sleep 5 && bunx playwright test tests/p0-critical.spec.ts && kill %1
scripts.test:bdd: bun run build && bun run preview --port 4321 & sleep 5 && bunx cucumber-js tests/features/ --require tests/features/steps/*.ts && kill %1
scripts.test:all: bun run test:unit && bun run test:e2e
scripts.audit:a11y: bun run build && bun run preview --port 4321 & sleep 5 && bunx playwright test tests/p1-accessibility.spec.ts --reporter=html && kill %1
scripts.ci:full: bun run typecheck:ci && bun run lint && bun run test:unit && bun run build && bun run audit:ci
